answer_1.quote: This paper proposes KiDG, a retrieval-free approach to incorporate knowledge into PDMs by automatically turning knowledge documents into simulated dialogues... The simulated dialogues constructed by KiDG are a powerful source of training data for retrieval-free knowledge-grounded dialogue systems.

answer_2.quote: We utilize the Perplexity (PPL) of the ground‑truth response, the average of BLEU, the Uni‑gram F1 and Distinct-2 to evaluate the generation results automatically.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. We randomly select 100 dialogue history and response pairs for evaluation. Three annotators evaluated dialogues based on the above two metrics... The results reveal that dialogues from BART+KiDial tend to be more coherent with dialogue history and ground‑truth knowledge while maintaining high fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators performed pairwise comparisons of system outputs, rating which response was better according to the evaluation criteria.
